# Pedro Vitor Brito

## About

Backend Developer based in São José dos Campos, Brazil. I build APIs, integrate applications and ERP systems, automate workflows, and work with the infrastructure and CI/CD practices that help software run reliably.

## Engineering focus

- Backend development and REST APIs
- Application and ERP integrations
- Software architecture and business rules
- Workflow automation with n8n
- Cloud infrastructure and CI/CD
- Troubleshooting authentication, OAuth, external APIs, and production integrations

## Selected projects

- MedaIO: Go REST API for content management with JWT authentication, PostgreSQL, Docker, Swagger/OpenAPI, and GitHub Actions CI. https://github.com/p-v-dev/MedaIO
- EduQuest: academic evaluation platform with a NestJS API, role-based access, exams, attempts, scoring, rankings, and an implemented administrative desktop client. The web client is in development and mobile is planned. https://github.com/p-v-dev/PIM-IV
- OrçaLink: functional Laravel MVP for creating, sharing, and managing freelancer quotes with explicit status rules, plan limits, and automated tests. https://github.com/p-v-dev/OrcaSim
- Bundle Valley Co: Tauri desktop app with React, Rust, and SQLite for tracking Stardew Valley Community Center bundles. https://github.com/p-v-dev/BundleValleyCo
- PWA - Construtora Mão de Obra LTDA: responsive business landing page published on GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions automation. https://github.com/p-v-dev/PWA
- Bundle Valley Co release: https://github.com/p-v-dev/BundleValleyCo/releases/tag/v1
- PWA live website: https://p-v-dev.github.io/PWA/

## Technologies

- Backend: Go, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Java
- Databases: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite
- Cloud and infrastructure: Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS, Terraform, Linux
- Additional technologies: Python, PHP / Laravel, Rust, React, n8n
